name: Enter-a-DOS
description: You press the forbidden TURBO button, shrink to 3 mm and get pulled into Uncle Mort's dead PC. Walk the motherboard in first person, fix it one POST line at a time and lure a virus back onto its floppy.
controls: WASD move · mouse look · Space jump · Shift run · E use · click/F zap · Tab checklist · Esc pause · touch and gamepad too
